title: Right-tensor comparison for intrinsic constant-ring realization
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $E_T$ be the canonical equivalence from fixed-scalar $\operatorname{ULift}(A)$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale site to ordinary modules over its constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. For every fixed-scalar sheaf $N$ there is a natural isomorphism $E_T(-)\otimes_{A_T}E_T(N)\cong E_T(-\otimes_A N)$, where the first tensor is the sheafification of sectionwise balanced tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

proof.text: For the fixed-scalar module-presheaf encoding P and module sheafification S along the constant-ring unit, construct the natural transformation P S to fixed-scalar sheafification followed by the intrinsic realization using the fixed-scalar sheafification unit. After forgetting to abelian sheaves its components are sheafifications of locally bijective maps. Explicit local injectivity and surjectivity prove these components invertible. The encoding P commutes with sectionwise right tensor via the identity on pure tensors.

Apply the two-variable sheafification tensor comparison along the intrinsic scalar map and fix the second factor N. Its naturality at (f,id) gives a natural right-tensor comparison. Identify siteSheafTensorRight with the monoidal right tensor by the proved independent-universe comparison. Compose with the encoding comparison of step 1, the sheafification bridge of step 1, and the strong monoidal fixed-scalar sheafification comparison; its counit isomorphism removes the two redundant sheafifications. This gives precisely the displayed natural isomorphism. All existence statements are eliminated inside the proof of Nonempty; no public definition chooses an arbitrary witness.

theorem proEtale_intrinsic_tensorRight_comparison
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))) :
    Nonempty (
      (Scheme.sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T A).functor ⋙
          SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            (A := Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T A)
            ((Scheme.sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T A).functor.obj N) ≅
        tensorRight N ⋙ (Scheme.sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T A).functor)
